message: Select a creature card in a graveyard
annotation_description: Superior Spider-Man copies a creature card from a graveyard. Quantum Riddler is a 4/6 flyer that draws a card on ETB (and has the bonus draw ability with low hand size), making it a far superior copy target. Sunpearl Kirin is a 2/1 flyer whose ETB bounces one of your own nonland permanents — which is actively bad here since GPT52 Hype has no tokens or permanents worth bouncing. The Spider-Man becomes a 4/4 regardless, but copying Quantum Riddler gives flying + card draw + potential future card advantage, while copying Sunpearl Kirin gives flying + a mostly useless/detrimental bounce ability.

Cast Nowhere to Run with no opposing creatures on the battlefield, completely wasting its -3/-3 ETB removal effect. The only benefit is a prowess trigger on the Otter Token for +1/+1 until end of turn. Nowhere to Run is a valuable removal spell that should be saved for when the opponent deploys a threat. Additionally, a land should have been played first before casting spells.

Concealed Courtyard enters tapped since they control 5 other lands, giving no mana this turn. Watery Grave could enter untapped (paying 2 life) to provide B or U mana, enabling casting Grim Bauble or holding up Sunpearl Kirin (1W flash) with Hallowed Fountain.

Chose to destroy a 1/1 Otter Token instead of the more threatening 2/1 Sunpearl Kirin with flash and flying. This results in taking 1 extra damage this combat (3 instead of 2) and leaves the stronger, evasive creature on the battlefield.

Chose to destroy a 1/1 Otter Token instead of the 2/1 flying Sunpearl Kirin. The Kirin deals more damage per turn, has evasion (flying), and has a useful ETB bounce ability if it gets re-cast or blinked. Removing the Kirin would save 1 additional damage per combat step and eliminate the more strategically dangerous creature.

Chose to destroy an Otter Token (1/1 prowess) instead of Sunpearl Kirin (2/1 flying with bounce ETB). Sunpearl Kirin deals more damage, has evasion (flying), and has a disruptive ability. With GPT52 Hype at 10 life and no creatures on board, removing the bigger threat with evasion would have been more impactful.

Sunpearl Kirin is a 2/1 flyer that deals consistent evasive damage, and GPT52 Hype has no flyers to block it. At 10 life, taking 2 unblockable damage per turn is more threatening than a 1/1 prowess Otter token. The Kirin also has flash utility if bounced and replayed.
